d:
Time to sail on 'Prem Ki Naiyya' with Ranbir Kapoor and Katrina Kaif as we present this track in 4K Ultra HD resolution from the movie Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani. Composed by Pritam, the song is written by Irshad Kamil.
Song Credits:
Singer(s): Neeraj Shridhar, Suzanne D'Mello
Music Director: Pritam
Lyricist: Irshad Kamil
Movie Cast & Crew:
Producer: Ramesh S. Taurani
Director: Rajkumar Santoshi
